The '''Carreras system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], just beyond the veil of the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]]. The system consisted of [[Carreras Major]], homeworld of the [[Shifala]], that was governed by [[Biala]], and [[Carreras Minor]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> Carreras Minor had a [[Carreras Minor's moon|moon]], where [[Ania Solo]] maintained her [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]].<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2013) 11|''Legacy'' (2013) 11]]</ref> In [[138 ABY]], as part of an effort by Empress [[Marasiah Fel]] to build a galaxy-spanning system of communications arrays, [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]] was dispatched to the system to oversee the construction of the [[Carreras G51 communications array]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
